newsitem.title: GERMANY: BADMINTON-OLYMPIC CHAMPION HOYER-LARSEN OUT OF GERMAN OPEN.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-OLYMPIC CHAMPION HOYER-LARSEN OUT OF GERMAN OPEN.

text.p: Third seed Hock Ong Ewe dumped Olympic badminton champion Poul-Erik Hoyer-Larsen out of the German Open in straight sets on Saturday to set up an all-Malaysian final.
The 15-13 15-12 win over the Danish top seed earned Hock a place in the final against Olympic bronze medallist Rashid Sidek. Sidek beat another Dane, Thomas Stuer-Lauridsen, 15-11 15-7.
With prize money of $125,000, the German Open is the second most important tournament in Europe after the All England championships.

In the women's event, which has produced several surprises, joint fifth seed Margit Borg of Sweden beat Indonesia's Yuni Kartika 11-6 11-3 to earn herself a place in the final against China's unseeded Jie Yao.
Jie, who put out Indonesian favourite Yuliani Santoso in the last 16, beat joint fifth seed Mette Pedersen of Denmark 12-10 11-4.
